task: Regression — predicts malaria case count per district-period
known_limitations: R² of 0.62 indicates moderate explanatory power — significant variance remains unexplained
No lag features — malaria transmission has known 2-4 week climate lag
District-level only — does not predict at chiefdom or facility level
Trained on synthetic data — requires retraining with real DHIS2 malaria data
intended_use: Forecasting malaria case burden at district level to support pre-positioning of ACTs and RDTs.
review_status: Pre-production — pending validation with real data
